photos.view: front left three-quarter view of a dark Tesla in a parking garage, showing the left fender, wheel, mirror and front corner

findings.reason: The front edge of the left fender has a sharp crease and deformation near the headlamp, with an irregular surface and the panel edge pushed out of line.

structural_reason: The fender is creased at the front corner and the surrounding corner looks misaligned, which suggests a front-corner impact that may have affected the parts behind the bumper and fender.
